video.title: Open Source, Faster Jev is HERE

protocol.note: Drafted from the transcript alone, without seeing any jevcut output or other labels.
protocol.times_from: Whisper small transcript; seconds in the source, so labels survive re-transcription

clips.why: Cold open on an AI playing snake locally at ~30 decisions/s, then what the model is: an open Jev-like (ASR 'Jeff') System One classifier that returns structured decisions, not text; lands on 'gives you a decision in sub-milliseconds' (62.4). The snake footage is on screen but the spoken claims stand alone.

Opinion: Leia is a bit less accurate than Jev, but Jev spent three years in stealth and people cloned it in about a week; lands on 'cloned it literally in like five days or a week' (416.1). 'The future is bright for open source' (422.3) is an acceptable later end.

Opens on the question 'what the heck is System 1?'; Thinking Fast and Slow: System 1 fast/instinctive vs System 2 slow/deliberate (today's LLMs); lands on 'that's exactly where Jev/Leia... classification models come from.' Stops before the on-screen example lists.

also_ok.why: Browser Use + Jev booked a flight search in seven seconds for $0.0039. Surprising fact, but opens on 'using it' (it = Jev) and is partly screen-shown, so optional.

negatives.why: Hype ('the introduction of Jev is literally changing everything') running into a list of models and parameter counts; no standalone point.
Live flight-booking demo narration ('watch this, it's gonna be so fast'); the point is what is on screen.
Playground sandwich example with 94%/6% numbers read off the screen.
'Did all of that in 39 milliseconds, three times faster than Jev'; numbers from an on-screen demo whose setup came earlier.
